blocked: kellyspublichouse.com (work list URL) 404s with an invalid TLS cert — the site is dead or reconfigured; Facebook (facebook.com/kellyspubsd/, their apparent current channel) returns 400 to curl and needs a browser. The only priced source found, allmenus.com (Grubhub family, tier 5), lists just 19 items across 6 sections (Appetizers, House Salads, All Sandwiches, USDA Choice Burgers, House Favorites, Desserts), address-verified (15817 Bernardo Center Dr Ste 113, San Diego CA 92127, matches work list) but with NO pizza section at all, even though multiple current sources (Yelp category info, a WebSearch summary) describe the pub as "under new management" now serving "breakfast" and "pizzas till close" as recent additions. Pizza and breakfast are core, current menu sections missing from this capture, and no second priced source (DoorDash, Uber Eats) could be located to cross-check or supplement — allmenus is tier 5 and needs an independent second source under playbook rule 5, which was not available.
notes: Under playbook rule 5, a lone tier-5 source with no independent cross-check is blocked, not filed. This is also stale by rule 6/7: the site itself signals a recent ownership/menu change (new pizza and breakfast programs) that the only available priced source predates. A browser pass on the Facebook page or a search for a DoorDash/Uber Eats storefront should resolve this.

name: Bánh Cuốn Phương Nga
blocked: No website is on file and none was found (name search turns up only directory/aggregator pages). Yelp (the likely richest source, including menu photos) 403s every curl attempt including via r.jina.ai and WebFetch. Of the aggregator pages found, banh-cuon-phuong-nga.menu-buzz.com is a confirmed farm site ("Claim This Listing" tell) whose page contains none of the prices a websearch summary attributed to it — those were fabricated by the summarizer, not real. zmenu.com 403s, mymenuweb.com and restaurantji.com load but carry no prices at all. The only real priced source is checkle.com (address-verified: 4016 54th St, San Diego CA 92105, matches work list exactly), a Next.js directory site with schema.org Menu JSON-LD listing 7 items (Special Combination Steamed Rolls .99, Special Combination Wet Cake .99, Steamed Rolls .99, Wet Cake With Meat Loaf .99, Steamed Rolls With Fried Pork Paste .99, Wet Cake With Fried Pork Paste .99, Crab Paste Vermicelli Soup .49) — plausibly the restaurant's whole menu given the business is literally named for its specialty (banh cuon), but this is a single, unconfirmed tier-5-equivalent source with no second independent priced source reachable to corroborate it.
notes: Per playbook rule 5, a single reachable tier-5-equivalent source with no independent corroboration is a real finding, marked blocked rather than filed. A browser pass on Yelp (menu photos, not the barred menu tab) would be the fastest way to confirm or expand this 7-item list.
